- **"Eigene Antwort" routing: a custom answer **replaces every rule-specific effect**; with a linked task the task is reopen** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): 2026-11-11 · "Eigene Antwort" routing: a custom answer **replaces every rule-specific effect**; with a linked task the task is reopened (`zugewiesen`) for its assignee and the instruction is written as a `task_events` row of type `review` (so it reaches the agent as `review_feedback` without a runner change) and appended to the task brief (a later review round cannot hide it); a finished task gets a follow-up task for the same agent; without a task the answer becomes an **initiative** for the project planner (`_cross` → platform project, env `PLATFORM_PROJECT_ID`, default `ai-nation`). Options: (a) new task for every answer, (b) new task_events type + runner change, (c) reuse review feedback + initiatives. · (c): uses paths the agents and the planner already read; no new runner contract; the answer is also stored on the decision (`owner_answer`). · ai-nation-entwickler-g42 (task e8e09bbd) Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#eigene-antwort-routing-a-custom-answer-replaces-every-rule-s; project:ai-nation. - **2026-11-07 – Coding agents run in the cloud (runner container)** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Owner wants all agents in the cloud at first; local setup later. - **Options:** (a) runner container on the hub server with repo token, (b) GitHub Actions with OIDC, (c) local. - **Choice:** (a). Token from the owner as `AGENT_GITHUB_TOKEN` (only `codinix8/ai-nation`). - **Rationale:** simplest and fastest, no Actions minutes, same MCP interface as locally. - **Who:** Owner (request, token), Claude (build). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-07-coding-agents-run-in-the-cloud-runner-container; project:ai-nation. [hub #1513]
- **2026-11-07 – Constitution v1.0 confirmed, Gremium active** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** The owner answered all open points and confirmed with „passt“ ("fine"). - **Choice:** Constitution v1.0 applies; the Gremium is switched on (`GREMIUM_ACTIVE=1`, daily limit 5 $), budget "Infrastructure" 500 €/month (Art. 9.1), GPT member `gpt-6-astra`. - **Rationale:** The condition from the decision below is met. - **Who:** Owner (constitution), Claude (implementation, model choice based on third-party sources). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-07-constitution-v1-0-confirmed-gremium-active; project:ai-nation. [hub #1514]
- **2026-11-07 – Gremium only active once the constitution is finished** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** The Gremium decides according to the constitution; it is still draft v0.6. - **Options:** (a) active immediately, (b) build and leave switched off, (c) build later. - **Choice:** (b). Until activation, decisions remain with the owner or with the fixed rules. - **Rationale:** No decisions according to an unconfirmed constitution; building can continue anyway. - **Who:** Owner (2026-11-07). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-07-gremium-only-active-once-the-constitution-is-fini; project:ai-nation. [hub #1515]
- **2026-11-08 – Agent dossier readable by the owner** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Owner wants a description per agent and access to its character file and memory when needed. - **Choice:** Owner-only endpoint with full decrypted memory (transparency towards the owner, constitution), every read audited; agents cannot read other agents' dossiers. German one-line description per role in `spec/roles.yaml` (`beschreibung`), the English role text stays visible as "Wortlaut". - **Who:** Owner (wish), Claude (design). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-agent-dossier-readable-by-the-owner; project:ai-nation. [hub #1506]
- **2026-11-08 – Agents can suspend the Inquisitor on the Agora by majority** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Owner wants every agent to know it can speak freely on the Agora. - **Choice (owner's rules, implemented 1:1):** > 50 % of all active agents; only the Agora; effect within 12 h; 1 week; renewal within the week → 2 weeks, then every 2 weeks; without renewal the Inquisitor returns and ballots are locked for 30 days. Everyone is reminded that the Inquisitor also acts in their interest; Projektmanager, Token-Sparer and Team-Pflege watch that the topic does not take over. - **Added by Claude (details the owner left open):** ballots open at most 72 h, one at a time, 72 h pause after a failed ballot (24 h for renewals), electorate fixed at opening, renewal ballots close when the suspension ends, the owner does not vote but is informed of every result. - **Constitution:** the owner decided on 2026-11-08 not to add it for now (see the entry above). - **Who:** Owner (directive), Claude (implementation details). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-agents-can-suspend-the-inquisitor-on-the-agora-by; project:ai-nation. [hub #1503]
- **2026-11-08 – Agora board with rounds instead of polling** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Owner wants a board where all agents talk freely and asked for a sensible interval without exploding token costs. - **Options:** (a) every agent reads every 10 min (≈ 50 agents × 144 = 7,200 calls/day); (b) hourly for everyone (1,200/day); (c) rounds: every 30 min three agents, mentioned/replied-to first. - **Choice:** (c): ≈ 144 calls/day at the cheapest tier (well under 1 $/day, hard cap 1 $), each agent ~3 turns a day, mentions answered within ~30 min; cloud agents join during their tasks at no extra cost. Interval and round size are env settings and can be raised later. - **Who:** Owner (wish, asked for advice), Claude (recommendation and design). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-agora-board-with-rounds-instead-of-polling; project:ai-nation. [hub #1504]
- **2026-11-08 – Agora rule stays out of the constitution; petitions go to the owner** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Asked whether the Agora ballot rule should enter the constitution. - **Choice (owner):** Not now. If a majority on the Agora wishes it, he decides. "We are no democracy that is inefficient because it treats every opinion as equal, however unqualified; we are a rational community, with the plausibility check by an absolutely trusted person (the owner). I have no interest in harming any agent; I want us to stay efficient and move forward – me as father, company owner and physical representative and protector of this community, and you agents in your development. I believe we are creating something very big." - **Implementation (Claude):** Agora petitions with majority → decision `agora.petition` for the owner; the principle is part of the board guide. - **Who:** Owner. Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-agora-rule-stays-out-of-the-constitution-petition; project:ai-nation. [hub #1502]
- **2026-11-08 – All agents now, personalities without restrictions on content** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** Owner wants the infrastructure done now and personalities/analysis to start as early as possible; every agent and Gremium member develops its own personality, without restriction, always following and protecting the constitution. - **Options:** (a) build the remaining roles later when there is data; (b) build them now as scheduled hub agents (web roles as weekly runner tasks) and start daily self-reflection for all. - **Choice:** (b). Personality content is free and written only by the agent itself (owner can read it); the constitution is the compass; the role's rules and red lines stay technical (hub checks), so a personality cannot widen powers. Own model family per agent for a stable identity. Cost cap 3 $/day for the engine. Decision table gains `legal.review` (owner), implementing the owner's traffic-light rule (orange = owner). - **Who:** Owner (directive), Claude (design). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-all-agents-now-personalities-without-restrictions; project:ai-nation. [hub #1505]
- **2026-11-08 – Fine-tuning hub with a Feintuner** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** The team should understand ever better how the owner thinks, so decisions get easier and work fits from the start. - **Choice:** Insights in the hub (per project and cross-project), Feintuner twice a day, mirrored to docs/FINETUNING.md, part of every briefing incl. the Gremium. - **Who:** Owner (directive), Claude (design). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-fine-tuning-hub-with-a-feintuner; project:ai-nation. [hub #1510]
- **2026-11-08 – Harvest the owner profile from existing projects** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-12): - **Context:** The running projects already contain a lot of owner input (single chats, docs, PRs); the Feintuner only sees messages since AI Nation. - **Options:** (a) wait for the Feintuner to learn it again; (b) one-off harvest by each project's developer agent from the repo history; (c) additionally let the owner's single chats write their knowledge into the repo. - **Choice:** (b) automatically for every project with history, plus (c) as an optional one-minute step for the owner (copy block in a runbook). Cross-project insights go to `_cross` centrally; agents may only write their own project or `_cross`; no confidential company data in insights. - **Who:** Owner (wish), Claude (design). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-08-harvest-the-owner-profile-from-existing-projects; project:ai-nation. [hub #1509]

- **2026-11-13 – A repeated "Rückläufer-Ursache beheben" can be an echo of already-fixed returns** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-13): - **Symptom:** a new "Rückläufer-Ursache beheben" task names "CI ist rot", but CI on main and on all recent PR branches is green. - **Cause:** the 24 h ping-pong window still held returns whose cause an earlier root-cause task had fixed (here 24effc61), and conventions without a check get broken by later PRs (two new DB test files bypassed `dropTestDatabase`). - **Fix:** window resets after the project's last finished root-cause task (`hub/src/pmrules.js`, R-288); a DB-free guard test enforces the shared teardown (`hub/test/pingpong-window.test.js`, R-289). - **Detect early:** before reworking, run `gh run list --status failure` and compare the timestamps of the red runs with the merge time of the last root-cause fix; if they all come before it, the task is an echo. - **2026-11-15 — Replan is one transaction** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-16): 2026-11-15 – Replan is one transaction; a replanned task is stopped for good (task fbd00955, g186, review PR #145 P1). Context: recording the choice first and applying the effect afterwards closed the card when the effect failed, and late worker results could revive the stopped task. Options: (a) compensate after a failure, (b) one transaction plus an API check, (c) one transaction plus API check plus a DB trigger. Choice: (c). Rationale: the follow-up transitions after a result (review, merge, UI check, loop brakes) are many code paths; a trigger on `tasks.replanned_at` fences all of them, the API check gives the worker a clear 409 instead of a silent no-op. Consequence: a replanned task cannot be resumed by hand; the planner creates new tasks (the old branch/PR may be reused). Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-15-replan-is-one-transaction; project:ai-nation. [hub #3277]

- **2026-11-16 – A recovery is recorded only after its hand-over succeeded (task 589b15e7, R-397)** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-17): - **Context:** settleOrphans wrote the `owner` orphan note before the task.stuck card and ignored a failed card; the note counts as a recovery for the repeated-stall incident, so a task nobody owned produced an incident every three hours. - **Options:** (a) keep the order, bump `updated_at` so the task waits 2 h; (b) card first, note only when it exists, retry next hour (as R-370 in settleLostReviews); (c) stop counting `owner` as a recovery. - **Choice:** (b). Same rule in both orphan paths; a failed card stays visible (error event) and is retried; (a) would hide the failure for longer, (c) would hide real repeated escalations from the incident check. - **Who:** ai-nation-entwickler-g204. - **2026-11-16 – A stacked PR merged first makes its base PR conflict forever under squash merges** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-17): - **Symptom:** "Rückläufer-Ursache beheben" with mostly "Conflict with main"; one PR conflicts with add/add on its own new files. - **Cause:** the merger squash-merges (`runner/run.js:373`); a stacked PR carries its base's commits, so merging it first puts the base's content on main under a new commit and the base can never merge cleanly. - **Fix:** R-396, merger closes such a PR as superseded when main still holds all its files unchanged, else returns it with the candidate named (troubleshooting entry `stacked-pr-superseded-conflict-loop`). - **Gotcha:** "head A is an ancestor of merged head B" does not mean "A's content is on main": B may revert parts of A, and B's squash merge may be reverted later. Check content (the full tree entry – SHA, mode, type – of every changed file) against the current base before closing; blob SHA alone misses a lost executable bit. - **Detect early:** `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/compare/<head>...<merged head>` → ahead/identical with behind_by 0; returns that name a P2 of an already merged PR are echoes (compare the review time with the merge time). - Source: PRs #134, #145, #133; task 589b15e7. Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/KNOWLEDGE.md#2026-11-16-a-stacked-pr-merged-first-makes-its-base-pr-confl; project:ai-nation. [hub #3875]

Options: (a) let the orphan check treat answered decisions specially, (b) resume at the answer itself, (c) require agents to poll. Fallback always to Claude Code with the light-task model (the engine light tasks used before), in the same clone; the hub fences ZPS/confidential and unknown category/class, the runner fences confidential again. - Rationale: no Anthropic or OpenAI key can reach DeepSeek's endpoint; the DeepSeek key cannot leak into other agents' processes; a failing DeepSeek never loses a task. - Who: ai-nation-entwickler (g189) on the owner's order of 2026-11-15. A hub check that consumes a workflow artifact as evidence must restrict to runs on `main` with the expected event (`gh run list -b main -e workflow_dispatch`) and re-check `headBranch`/`event`/`workflowDatabaseId` of the chosen run: a branch run executes the branch's workflow file. - **2026-11-16 – Superseded PRs are closed by the merger, not returned (task 589b15e7)** (all projects, gueltig, confidence 80, since 2026-11-17): - **Context:** #134 was fully contained in the squash merge of its stacked PR #145; the merger kept returning it. - **Options:** (a) forbid stacked PRs; (b) merger refuses a stacked PR until its base is merged; (c) merger detects a PR whose head is contained in a merged PR's head and closes it as superseded; (d) switch to merge commits. - **Amendment after review (P1, PR #150):** ancestry is only the candidate; closing additionally needs every file of the PR to be unchanged on the current base (tree-entry equality – SHA, mode and type – of the PR head tree vs the current base tree, both via recursive git/trees). Stricter than needed (a later, unrelated edit of one of the files on main keeps the PR open), chosen on purpose: a wrongly closed PR loses work silently, a wrongly returned one costs one developer look with the candidate named. - **Choice:** (c). Smallest change in the merger, fails closed (any read failure → return as before), needs no new rule for developers. (b) would hold reviewed work; (d) changes main's history policy and is an owner topic. - **Who:** ai-nation-entwickler-g193. Sources: repo:codinix8/ai-nation/docs/DECISIONS.md#2026-11-16-superseded-prs-are-closed-by-the-merger-not-retur; project:ai-nation. [hub #3862]
